description: Core window capability, read-only System page activity, details and startup items, opening fixed System Settings panes, read-only startup-volume capacity and analysis of fixed locations, the Processes list and asking a regular app to quit, the read-only Developer scan and adding folders for it, the read-only Cleanup scan with its folder access requests, review, preview and approved moves into quarantine, and restoring (including choosing a restore-only folder) or permanently deleting quarantined items (ADR-012), reading and saving preferences, Open at login, asking for notification permission, excluded folders and removing folder access, and reading or clearing the activity log (ADR-013), showing items and the quarantine folder in Finder, setting the window theme to match the appearance preference, dragging the window from its overlay title bar, the Apps page's read-only scan, sending leftovers and installers to review and moving a confirmed app to the Trash (ADR-017), the Storage Browse view and sending chosen items to review (ADR-018), the Files tools (ADR-019), Maintenance's measuring, confirmed tasks and sending a launch agent to review (ADR-020), issue alerts (ADR-021), and listing and closing browser tabs (ADR-022). Commands no screen uses (the process summary and the chosen-folder scan) are not granted.
